what: Each letter of the big English title hides 70px below its mask cell, and once any part of the title enters the viewport it rises into place once — later letters get delays that grow by 20·30·40…ms (0·20·50·90·140·200·270·350·440·540·650ms) and durations shrink accordingly (1.2s → .5s), so all letters settle together at 1.15~1.2s. The curve also shifts per letter from cubic-bezier(0,1,.1,1) to (.16,1,.37,1), starting later, so the front letters spring up and the back letters follow softly

options.y: Hidden depth (px), default 70 — below 1140px y-tablet (default 64), below 840px y-phone (default 38)
options.total: Time for everything to settle (ms), default 1200
options.step: Extra delay added per character (ms), default 10 — delay = step/2 × i × (i + 3)
options.mask: 0 means it rises without a masking cell (masked by default)
options.[data-fx-part=char]: When letter cells are placed directly (if absent, the text is split to build them — words are wrapped as chunks so a line never breaks mid-word)

note: The original is the appear effect of a site builder (IntersectionObserver threshold 0 · transition-delay/duration/timing set separately on each letter span). From the 8th letter on, the end is pulled in by 50ms to 1.15s (original values as they are)

from.where: index.html·about.html·live.html·event.html section titles (LIVE INFORMATION·EVENT INFORMATION·ARTISTS·ARCHIVES·Venues — original _c131~_c145.appear: translate 0 70px, delay 0~650ms, duration 1200~500ms)
